scripts.build: pnpm --filter @outbound-tools/toolkit run build && pnpm --filter @outbound-tools/api run build && pnpm --filter @outbound-tools/cli run build

pnpm.//: esbuild (via tsx) ships a prebuilt binary and is not used in the Docker image (build uses tsc, runtime runs prod deps). Mark its build script as intentionally skipped so pnpm v10/v11 don't error on it.
